title: American election denial 'seeping in by osmosis' as right-wing distrust drives falling confidence in Canadian voting - The Hill Times
text:
Declining confidence in Canada’s electoral processes since 2019 is being driven primarily by a significant lack of trust among Conservative voters and those on the political right, according to a new McGill-led study that observers say reflects the “unfriendly fire” of...
